description: Translink General transit feed specification (GTFS) is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport and Main Roads. Timetable data and stop locations for SEQ and regional Translink urban bus, rail and ferry services. In addition to this data, the Translink PT Performance Dashboard provides visual and interactive performance data on patronage, on-time-running, fines and warnings, passenger injuries, and customer experience metrics. Coverage: Transport and Main Roads. The portal files it under the publisher Transport and Main Roads. Its tags are Age Friendly Community, GTFS, maps and spatial data, public transport, qconnect. It offers 21 resource(s) in XLSX, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-03 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
